description: This file defines a Java interface 'Authenticator' for authentication mechanisms within the OFBiz framework. It declares methods for initializing, authenticating, logging out, syncing users, updating passwords, and query methods for weight, synchronization status, singleton expectation, and enablement status.

classes.name: Authenticator
classes.description: A Java interface specifying the contract for authentication implementations within OFBiz.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Authenticator with the given LocalDispatcher.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on username, password, and context whether it's for a service call.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out a user, given their username.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of this authenticator for ordering purposes.

methods.name: isUserSynchronized
methods.description: Checks if the user is synchronized back to OFBiz.

methods.name: isSingleAuthenticator
methods.description: Indicates if this is the only authenticator expected.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if this authenticator is enabled.
